sam: FYI the nightly SAST/DAST produced 9 medium and 1 high. Compliance wants an auditable flow for any auto-actions and a plan to remove long-lived SA keys from scanner runners. Can we design something low-noise?

nina: +1. Proposal: 1) GH Action runs as GitHub App and writes an immutable audit event BEFORE any triage action. 2) Evidence stored as encrypted pointer + signed sha256 (no raw payloads by default). 3) If decrypt is needed, use an ephemeral KMS proxy that issues scoped tokens tied to PR and reviewer.

rob: On the proxy: it should accept a workload identity JWT, validate PR and reviewer binding, then return a short-lived decrypt token (ttl 5m). Log: actor, pr, key, key_version, reason. Deny grants for automated pages. Example call:```bash
curl -X POST https://kms-proxy.internal/issue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLOAD_JWT" \
  -d '{"key":"scan-keys/scan-test","reason":"repro:5123456789","ttl":300}'
```

sec-bot: [scan-run] nightly-scan completed: 9 medium, 1 high (auth-redirect in api-gateway). Report: https://scans.internal/5123456789

oncall-sre: Please do not page us for each finding. Page immediately for P0/P1. For P2/P3 send an aggregated digest every 24h with: list, owners, links, repro pointer, runbook link. Make digest idempotent and include runbook steps to revoke tokens.

compliance: Retention: audit events + signed pointers = 3 years. If teams need raw repro artifacts, they must file an exception with justification and retention plan. Also we require a signed audit entry when proxy issues a token (include PR id).

sam: I sketched a minimal GH Action: it calls scanner, writes audit entry, stores pointer, then decides escalation. It runs as the GitHub App. Snippet:```yaml
name: scan-triage
on: [pull_request, schedule]
jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: |
          curl -X POST "$SCANNER/api/triage" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.SCAN_APP_TOKEN }}" -d '{"pr": "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"}'
```

nina: Make sure the action writes the audit entry first and uses the App identity (no user tokens). Add attestation to the PR with the audit-id and signature.

rob: RBAC plan: rotate out long-lived SA, add workload identities + iam:AssumeRole for the GitHub App. Proxy will check reviewer binding before granting.

sam: Action items: 1) rob -> KMS proxy + policy (ETA Thu) 2) nina -> GH Action + audit write + PR attestation (ETA Wed) 3) oncall-sre -> digest format + runbook template (ETA Mon) 4) compliance -> sample signed audit entry for review (ETA Tue). I'll open ISSUE-SEC-302 and link here.

compliance: approve sample flow once we see signed audit sample and retention config.

sam: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
